notes: Game Anatomy Jam entry titled Not All Heroes Wear Swords. Complete Unity 2021.2 project (Assets+ProjectSettings+Packages) with MainMenu, Main, sewing/quenching minigames, GameOver, and Victory scenes; author-made models, sprites, and original audio. MIT. Official Unity packages only (2D, Input System, TextMeshPro as a package with no vendored fonts, Visual Scripting). No bundled fonts, no FXAA, no Unity Standard Assets, no DOTween, no EmojiOne, no Asset Store packages, no LFS. ~5.9M src snapshot.
